title: Understanding Metal Corrosion by Four-Dimensional Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (4D-STEM)
content: Metal corrosion poses a critical challenge to the longevity and reliability of structural materials across a range of applications. In this talk, we will introduce our recent works applying four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) techniques to understand the nanoscale mechanisms driving corrosion in several metal systems.
